items.title: Raycast combines voice dictation and screen awareness in new AI feature
items.excerpt: A Raycast update lets Mac users talk to AI about whatever is on screen without having to explain the context.
items.rationale: A new Mac feature that combines voice with screen context. It is a different release from Raycast's iOS keyboard app (10-30).

items.title: DJI, 라이다·레이더·AI 통합 산업용 드론 '매트리스 5T' 출시
items.excerpt: DJI가 라이다·밀리미터파 레이더와 AI 영상 분석을 결합해 야간·악천후에도 점검·긴급 대응이 가능한 소형 산업용 드론 매트리스 5T를 출시했다.
items.rationale: A new hardware launch with on-board AI analysis. It adds a drone/industrial category and a Korean outlet.

items.title: The Siri AI waitlist is gone in iOS 27: How to try the beta today
items.excerpt: The wait is over for trying Siri AI on iOS 27: Apple has dropped the beta waitlist. Here's what you need to know to get started.
items.rationale: A concrete access change: Apple removed the Siri AI beta waitlist, so any iOS 27 user can turn it on now. Earlier cards covered features (10-27) and third-party app access (11-04), not this.

items.title: I went hands on with the new Snap Specs — and found out why they could soon be a useful workplace tool
items.excerpt: A hands-on with Snap's untethered sixth-generation Specs AR glasses (£1,999) ahead of their UK launch: a fast voice AI assistant, live speech translation shown as subtitles over the speaker, heads-up Maps and a mid-air keyboard for Google Docs.
items.rationale: First hands-on with Snap's sixth-gen Specs before their UK launch, with a £1,999 price. The voice AI assistant and live subtitle translation are the main features. The section has not run a Snap Specs card in the last 30 days.

items.title: Pudu TOMO S robot mower sharpens its own blades at the dock
items.excerpt: Pudu's first residential robot mower combines 360-degree LiDAR, AI vision and network RTK for wire-free navigation, an AI Mowing Planner that schedules around weather, and a dock that sharpens its rotary blades; on sale early 2027.
items.rationale: A new product launch where AI vision and an AI planner do the navigation and scheduling. It adds a home-robotics category, and no mower has run in the last 30 days.

https://www.zdnet.com/business/siri-ai-b.new_action: Apple ended the Siri AI beta waitlist in iOS 27, opening the beta to every eligible user (11-05). The 10-27 card covered iOS 27.2 features and the 11-04 card (theverge.com/tech/1025694) covered third-party app access; neither reported the waitlist removal.
